summary: Iteration 33 — Media budget restore validated end-to-end in REVIEW scope. All 6 unit tests in tests/shared/test_media_budget_restore.py pass; 32 regression tests across shared PDF races / import extended / follow-up regressions pass. Live preview backend: B1 media/usage shape correct (limits 4e9 / 50000, remaining computed, admin-only). B2 full PDF import (init, chunk uploads with X-Chunk-Sha256, duplicate chunk 0 re-send returns {received:0, duplicate:true}, status matches, complete + worker → phase='review', product_count==3). B3 interrupted-resume re-init returns same upload_id with phase='uploading' and only acknowledged chunks; final chunk + complete OK; slot not blocked by ACTIVE_IMPORT_LIMIT. B4 commit + dedupe created:1 skipped:2, storage_path adopted from imports/<jid>/previews/ (no second master copy), thumbnail_path yash-trade/products/imported/<rid>-thumb.png; usage delta import_master +1 and pdf_preview -1; idempotent recommit returns identical numbers. B5 customer image access serves both storage_path and thumbnail_path as image/png with Cache-Control containing 'no-store' but WITHOUT the 'private' directive (server returns 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' — DEVIATION from the spec 'private, no-store'); unadopted preview chunk path returns 404 MEDIA_NOT_FOUND; hidden-product rule returns 403 MEDIA_PRIVATE for customer while admin still 200. B7 4 distinct active imports admitted; 5th init returns 429 ACTIVE_IMPORT_LIMIT; after cancel one → 5th succeeds; re-init cancelled identity → 409 IMPORT_CANCELLED. F1 UI /media-usage via Panel → Products → View All Products → 'Storage accounting & alerts' renders media-usage-title, media-tracked-bytes ('43,181,743 tracked bytes · 49 objects'), media-write-budget shows '4,000,000,000 bytes / 50000 objects', media-remaining line present with computed values, no media-limit-reached, 5 media-group-<purpose> lines, Refresh accounting button works. F2 was NOT driven because the /pdf-import screen uses a native file picker that cannot be reliably scripted in Playwright web preview; B2/B3/B4/B5 already validate the underlying API flow the UI wraps. Cleanup: all active/dangling review imports were cancelled at test end.

minor.issue: Cache-Control response is 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' — missing the 'private' directive required by the review spec. Functionally safe (no-store already prevents caching) but deviates from the stated header shape.

action_items: Optional: add the 'private' directive to the Cache-Control header on GET /api/files/{path} responses to exactly match the review spec ('private, no-store'). No behavioural regression, just header consistency.
